about_the_game:
Start your own gardening service in a charming neighborhood and bring life back to every yard you visit! 🌱 In Garden Hustle, you’ll take on a variety of wholesome, relaxing jobs, each as a bite-sized mini-game designed to be satisfying and stress-free.

Mow overgrown lawns in neat patterns while avoiding cheeky garden gnomes, plant colorful flowers exactly where your clients want them, blow autumn leaves into tidy piles, clean backyard pools until they sparkle, and much more. Every job feels different, and each is a chance to unwind while still keeping your business growing.

As you complete tasks and earn money, invest in better tools like faster mowers, bigger watering cans, and premium soil to work more efficiently and unlock new plants. Between jobs, head home to your own garden and decorate it however you like, showing off your favorite plants, furniture, and quirky garden ornaments.

With cozy hand-drawn visuals, gentle ambient music, and gameplay that’s all about taking your time, Garden Hustle is the perfect place to relax, get creative, and watch your business blossom one happy customer at a time.

FEATURES

• Relaxing, bite-sized mini-games for every job type

• A variety of tasks: mowing, planting, leaf blowing, pool cleaning, and more

• Upgrade tools and unlock new plants as you grow your business

• Decorate your own personal garden with plants and ornaments

• Cozy 2D art and peaceful garden soundscapes

• Wholesome, slow-paced gameplay with a touch of humor

🌼 Add Garden Hustle to your wishlist and be the first to know when it blooms onto Steam!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS (Proton-8 Recommended)
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 or higher, ATI X1600 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Proton-8 Recommended

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or above
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 (M2 and M3) or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1280x720 minimum resolution, OpenGL 2.0 Support, and recommended dedicated graphics card with 128 MB of RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: M1, M2, M3 Silicon Mac & ARM Supported
